newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Albanian mayor arrested after Macedonian riot.
newsitem.headline: Albanian mayor arrested after Macedonian riot.

text.p: Police arrested the mayor of the western Macedonian town of Gostivar on Thursday for inciting violence after rioting in which two ethnic Albanians were shot dead, the state radio said.
President Kiro Gligorov appealed for calm in a broadcast to the nation and described the fighting on Wednesday as a blow to inter-ethnic relations in the former Yugoslav republic.
The deaths of the ethnic Albanians prompted a protest from the government of neighbouring Albania.
More than 50 people were seriously hurt in the clashes, including a citizen of Albania who was said to be critically ill.
The violence erupted after police removed the Albanian national flag from Gostivar town hall under a new law which limits the flying of flags to special occasions.
The radio not identify the killers of the two men.
Ethnic Albanians are demanding political equality and their own university in Macedonia, where they claim to make up around 40 percent of the population.
The government says census figures show the figure is around 22 percent and Albanian demands for stronger identity are fiercely opposed by Macedonian nationalists.
